shield_wall.description: Raise cover to Full for self and adjacent allies until next turn.

taunt.description: Force an enemy to target this Guardian.

bulwark.description: Create a defensive zone; allies inside gain Half cover.

hunters_mark.description: Mark a target; it takes extra damage and is easier to hit.

pinning_shot.description: Pin a target, reducing its movement next turn.

firebolt.description: Fire damage that ignites flammable tiles/objects.

grease.description: Create a flammable oil slick on target tiles.

frost_nova.description: Freeze tiles to ice; slows and can freeze water.

shadowstep.description: Teleport to a tile in line of sight; ignores terrain cost.

smoke_bomb.description: Create smoke that blocks line of sight.
